
var sink int

func arithmetic(b *testing.B) {
 value := 1
 for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ { value = (value * 33 + i) & 65535 }
 sink = value
}

func measure(name string, operation func(*testing.B)) {
 result := testing.Benchmark(operation)
 fmt.Printf("Benchmark%s\t%s\t%s\n", name, result.String(), result.MemString())
}

func main() {
 testing.Init()
 flag.Parse()
 // Check observable work before timing; a fast but incorrect fixture must fail.
 probe := testing.B{N: 7}
 fields(&probe)
 if sink != 21 { panic("fields checksum") }
 method(&probe)
 if sink != 21 { panic("method checksum") }
 inherited(&probe)
 if sink != 21 { panic("inherited checksum") }
 virtual(&probe)
 if sink != 12 { panic("virtual checksum") }
 create(&probe)
 if sink != 6 { panic("create checksum") }
 sink = -1
 nullable(&probe)
 if sink != 5 { panic("nullable checksum") }
 success(&probe)
 if sink != 6 { panic("success checksum") }
 failure(&probe)
 if sink != 7 { panic("failure checksum") }
 measure("Arithmetic", arithmetic)
 measure("Fields", fields)
 measure("Method", method)
 measure("Inherited", inherited)
 measure("Virtual", virtual)
 measure("Create", create)
 measure("Nullable", nullable)
 measure("Success", success)
 measure("Failure", failure)
 measure("HTTP", httpHandler)
}
